summary: Cline is a TypeScript monorepo (Bun 1.3.13 workspaces) whose terminal agent lives in apps/cli (package @cline/cli, entry apps/cli/src/index.ts, bundled to apps/cli/dist/index.js by `bun -F @cline/cli build` after `bun run build:sdk` compiles the @cline/shared|llms|agents|core|sdk|ui packages to dist/). The bundle must be executed by Bun, not Node, because the TUI layer (@opentui/core) uses bun:ffi. One-shot headless use is `cline --yolo "<prompt>"`: yolo auto-approves every tool, enables submit_and_exit, and (together with --data-dir sandbox mode) forces an in-process local backend so no hub daemon is spawned. Model calls go through @cline/llms; the `openai-compatible` provider uses @ai-sdk/openai-compatible chat completions against a per-provider baseUrl stored in <data-dir>/settings/providers.json, which `cline auth --provider openai-compatible --baseurl <url> --apikey <k> --modelid <m> --data-dir <dir>` writes non-interactively. The API key also resolves from OPENAI_API_KEY. Telemetry (PostHog/OTel) is compiled out unless TELEMETRY_SERVICE_API_KEY / OTEL_TELEMETRY_ENABLED are set at build time, and CLINE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 skips the startup update check.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=buildpack-deps:bookworm
FROM ${BASE}

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git unzip bash \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Self-contained Bun runtime under /opt/harness (the Cline CLI must run on Bun: OpenTUI uses bun:ffi).
ARG BUN_VERSION=1.3.13
ENV BUN_INSTALL=/opt/harness/bun \
    BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR=/opt/harness/bun/cache \
    PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/bun:$PATH
RUN set -eux; \
    arch="$(uname -m)"; \
    case "$arch" in \
      x86_64)  pkg=bun-linux-x64 ;; \
      aarch64|arm64) pkg=bun-linux-aarch64 ;; \
      *) echo "unsupported arch $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/bun /opt/harness/bin /tmp/bun; \
    curl -fsSL -o /tmp/bun.zip "https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v${BUN_VERSION}/${pkg}.zip"; \
    unzip -q /tmp/bun.zip -d /tmp/bun; \
    mv "/tmp/bun/${pkg}/bun" /opt/harness/bun/bun; \
    chmod +x /opt/harness/bun/bun; \
    ln -s /opt/harness/bun/bun /opt/harness/bun/bunx; \
    rm -rf /tmp/bun /tmp/bun.zip; \
    /opt/harness/bun/bun --version

# Harness source (repo root) -> /opt/harness/src. Build the SDK packages, then the CLI bundle.
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN cd /opt/harness/src \
 && bun install \
 && bun run build:sdk \
 && bun -F @cline/cli build \
 && test -f /opt/harness/src/apps/cli/dist/index.js

# Entrypoint wrapper: runs the harness's own CLI bundle under Bun.
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/usr/bin/env bash' 'exec /opt/harness/bun/bun /opt/harness/src/apps/cli/dist/index.js "$@"' > /opt/harness/bin/cline \
 && chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/cline \
 && mkdir -p /work /out

ENV CLINE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1 \
    CI=1
run_command: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p /out/cline-data; export CLINE_SANDBOX=1 CLINE_SANDBOX_DATA_DIR=/out/cline-data CLINE_LOG_PATH=/out/cline-data/logs/cline.log; cline auth --provider openai-compatible --apikey "$OPENAI_API_KEY" --modelid "$CLINE_MODEL_ID" --baseurl "$OPENAI_BASE_URL" --data-dir /out/cline-data --cwd "$PWD" </dev/null; cline --yolo --data-dir /out/cline-data --cwd "$PWD" -P openai-compatible -m "$CLINE_MODEL_ID" -k "$OPENAI_API_KEY" --retries 5 -v "$TASK" </dev/null 2>&1 | tee /out/cline-run.log
check_command: cline --version && cline auth --provider openai-compatible --apikey check --modelid gpt-4o --baseurl http://127.0.0.1:9/v1 --data-dir /tmp/cline-check </dev/null && test -f /tmp/cline-check/settings/providers.json
notes: Why this shape: Cline has no base-URL environment variable for its providers; the base URL lives in the provider settings file. `cline auth --provider openai-compatible ... --baseurl` is the documented non-interactive way to seed it (base URL is only accepted for openai-compatible / openai-native, and openai-native uses the Responses API, so openai-compatible chat completions is the right transport for the proxy). Because sandbox mode (--data-dir / CLINE_SANDBOX=1) points CLINE_PROVIDER_SETTINGS_PATH at <data-dir>/settings/providers.json for both the auth and the run, the same --data-dir is passed to both, and everything Cline persists (sessions, db, logs, teams, provider settings) lands under /out/cline-data. --yolo auto-approves all tools and, with sandbox, forces the in-process local backend, so no hub daemon is started and the process exits when the turn completes. Model ID is arbitrary for openai-compatible (unregistered IDs are accepted), so CLINE_MODEL_ID=gpt-4o is just a safe default; the proxy substitutes the real model. stdin is redirected from /dev/null so the CLI's piped-stdin detection does not try to read it. Telemetry is compiled out (no TELEMETRY_SERVICE_API_KEY at build time, OTEL disabled); the only non-proxy network attempt would be the best-effort model-catalog refresh, which is caught and logged. Build note: `bun install` runs lifecycle scripts only for trustedDependencies (better-sqlite3 uses prebuilt binaries; grpc-tools is for the VS Code workspace) and applies the repo's patches/; the CLI build also builds the hub webview via vite. The wrapper /opt/harness/bin/cline simply execs Bun on the built bundle; the harness source is unchanged. Previous attempt failed only because analysis exhausted its turn budget; this recipe is complete.
